name: Landscapes
blurb: Hand-built places and skies that move: coasts, peaks, cities at night.
game_uses_zh: 关卡背景、营地、探索地图

name: UI
blurb: Working interfaces in text: apps, terminals, tools and system screens.
game_uses_zh: 游戏菜单、终端交互、任务面板

name: Live Data
blurb: Charts, gauges and tables that keep updating.

name: Explainers
blurb: Animated diagrams that show how something works, step by step.
game_uses_zh: 教程、任务树、系统关系图

blurb: Words that move: big letterforms, credits, tickers and reading effects.
game_uses_zh: 标题、字幕、解密文字、片尾

name: Solids
blurb: Rotating 3D forms, shaded in characters.
game_uses_zh: 道具展示、立体徽标、旋转拾取物

name: Cosmos
blurb: Planets, stars, orbits and the craft that visit them.
game_uses_zh: 太空背景、星图、飞行场景

name: Motion Lab
blurb: Simulations: pendulums, waves, particles and fields.
game_uses_zh: 弹道、波动、运动规律参考

name: Weather & Wild
blurb: Rain, fire, wind, plants and the elements.

name: Animals
blurb: Living things, from cats to whales.
game_uses_zh: 生物外观、待机循环、生态场景

name: Things
blurb: Everyday objects with moving parts.
game_uses_zh: 交互物件、装置、道具图标

blurb: Maths and code that draw: fractals, automata, attractors.
game_uses_zh: 程序背景、分形、细胞自动机

name: Demoscene
blurb: Classic demo effects: fire, plasma, tunnels and warps.
game_uses_zh: 技能背景、传送、火焰、隧道

name: Arcade
blurb: Little games that play themselves.
game_uses_zh: 观察规则与节奏；自动播放动画不代表可操作游戏

name: Rules & Frames
blurb: Animated dividers, borders and frames for layouts.
game_uses_zh: 对话框、面板、界面分隔

name: Occasions
blurb: Festivals, holidays and celebrations.
game_uses_zh: 通关、奖励、庆典

name: Cities of the World
blurb: Famous places around the world, hand-built and alive.
game_uses_zh: 城市关卡、地标、环境气氛

game_uses_zh: 角色设计、待机、情绪表达

name: Science & Learning
blurb: How things work, from cells to the water cycle.
game_uses_zh: 机制教学、科学题材、可视化

name: Music & Sound
blurb: Equalisers, turntables, sequencers and waveforms.

name: Food & Drink
blurb: Steam, sizzle and pour: food that moves.

blurb: Festivals, streets, monsoons and moments from across India.
game_uses_zh: 地域题材环境与节庆气氛
